title: Chlorine is in what type of bond?
question: Chlorine is in what type of bond?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT bc.bond_type
FROM bond_connected AS bc
JOIN atom AS a ON bc.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT bc.bond_type
FROM bond_connected AS bc
JOIN atom AS a ON bc.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
